cost: O(input bytes) parsing, O(file bytes) trait copy buffer; OS/memory backend costs remain separate; FNV O(bytes)/O(1).
description: Public types, limits parser, FileSystem dispatch and hashing.
forward: parse_size trims, parses u64, multiplies by 1024^suffix with checked_mul. Limits starts defaults and applies comma entries in order. open mem constructs Vfs+limits; real constructs RealFs; dir canonicalizes nonempty root. Trait copy read then write returns byte length; read_to_string UTF8-decodes successful read.
inverse: Same Limits admits omitted defaults, whitespace and repeated overwritten keys. exists=false admits missing/denied/type errors; copy length admits arbitrary equal-length data. Hash preimages collide.
limitations: Finite checks only; partial source syntax, no expanded semantic AST.
No numerical surrogate: categorical/effect semantics lack useful metric; future caps 1/2/5/10 require domain and reference.
state: Duplicate limit keys last-win. exists collapses every stat error to false. FNV uses wrapping u64 product. Limits affect mem dispatch only.
